mechanism: Both drugs have anticholinergic and CNS depressant effects; oxybutynin may inhibit fentanyl metabolism via CYP3A4, increasing fentanyl levels and respiratory depression risk.
action: Monitor respiratory function closely; consider dose reduction of fentanyl; assess for constipation, urinary retention, and CNS depression; use alternative anticholinergic with lower CYP3A4 interaction if possible.
